analysis: Robust five-class relative spatial heat trajectory classification
classification_scope: relative spatial heat trajectory within Kaduwela; not an absolute warming/cooling significance claim
relative_heat_definition: within-year percentile rank of observed LST_C among all 2,194 grids
direction_definition: Theil-Sen slope of yearly relative heat percentile across all available years
rules: Emerging: relative Sen slope >= +0.01/year, baseline < 0.75, recent >= 0.75
Intensifying: relative Sen slope >= +0.01/year and not Emerging
Persistent Hot: abs(relative Sen slope) < 0.01/year and long-term relative heat median >= 0.50
Persistent Cool: abs(relative Sen slope) < 0.01/year and long-term relative heat median < 0.50
step23_absolute_lst_role: Mann-Kendall p/q and absolute LST Sen slope retained as separate inferential/descriptive evidence; not overwritten by trajectory labels

2017_policy.secondary: full relative-trajectory method repeated with 2017 omitted

threshold_sensitivity.purpose: robustness only; reference thresholds are not selected by optimizing class counts
